data.control_account: 1.04.02.06.03.01- CS_SEIT SLP_A Node Integration, Assembly, Test, & Checkout
data.leadership_messages: WBS definition was incorrect and pointed to STOS systems engineering which is false for this element. The CAM provided the following WBS definition which somehow got lost in handoff between NG and GOV, “This element contains the scope for the integration and testing of C&L configurations in the Command and Launch (C&L) System Integration Lab (CSIL) in support of the INC 1, 2, and 3 test campaigns. It contains the work needed in order to effectively plan, develop test plans and procedures, execute test, and generate test reports for relevant integration and testing at the SLP-A Node level. It contains the scope for discrete specialty test at the SLP-A Node level, and SLP-A site/node integration and sell-off activities.” 2. 10 work packages under this CA for Sentinel SLP 3. CA is focused on Sentinel SLP node level testing activities.
data.rationale: There is strong confidence that the prime contractor has established mature planning of work packages supporting MMIII SLP node level testing. It covers integration planning, test planning, test procedure, development, dry running, test execution, and test reporting for Sentinel node L3 SLP

areas.text: Aside from WBS dictionary and definitions having incorrect/outdated information, NG CAM provided updated definition, and the work packages captures the high level program objectives
Scope is sufficiently captured in work and planning packages to support IIR #2, however, P6 will be required for subsequent review in order to make a complete and full assessment.
Element covers Sentinel SLP node level 3 test activities.
